limitations: The sequence model has no SHAP-equivalent explanation, so it cannot produce reason codes. It is a second opinion, not a decision-maker — docs/ARCHITECTURE.md requires a reason code on every block.
The ensemble weight is a chosen constant, not a fitted one. Fitting it would need a fourth split to avoid selecting on the test set.
Windows are fixed-length and left-padded; an account's first transactions are scored on mostly padding.
